source.author: verg
source.text: Suscipiunt famulae, collapsaque membra marmoreo referunt thalamo stratisque reponunt.
source.text_original: Suscipiunt famulae, collapsaque membra / marmoreo referunt thalamo stratisque reponunt.
source.text_english: The maidservants take him up, and bear the fallen limbs back to the marble chamber and lay them on the couch.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille suo collapsam pectore matrem sustinuit magnaque senem cervice recepit.
reuse.text_original: ille suo collapsam pectore matrem / sustinuit magnaque senem cervice recepit.
reuse.text_english: He supported his mother as she collapsed against his breast, and with his great neck he received the old woman.
